about_the_game:
Blast'em with Style!

The official soundtrack of Exploding Judo Federation contains 16 tracks in both MP3 and lossless FLAC format.

If more tracks are added to the game later, they will be automatically added to this DLC without requiring any additional purchase!

Additional notes

The tracks "GO! GO! GO!", "Golden Stigma" (from 8-Colors Star Guardians+) and "Come On (Get Serious!)" (from Schwarzerblitz) are not included in the Exploding Judo Federation soundtrack
